Dr. Tiffany Brown, Commissioner
  Francine Kerridge, Director

  FINISHED AGENDA & MINUTES

CALL TO ORDER

At 5:31 PM, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, called the meeting to order.

ROLL CALL

Commissioners Present: Bender, Okatch, Orozco, Soto, Tushnet

Commissioners Absent: Brown

Also present: Francine Kerridge, Director, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer,
Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney, Karen Baldwin, City Clerk Analyst.

Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, spoke; and announced that Commissioner Brown was
excused from the meeting.

ELECTION OF CHAIR, AND IF NECESSARY, VICE CHAIR

A motion was made by Commissioner Tushnet, to elect Vice Chair Tushnet for Chair of the
Police Oversight Commission. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Bender, Okatch, Orozco, Soto, Tushnet
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  1  Brown

A motion was made by Commissioner Orozco, to elect Commissioner Soto for Vice Chair of
the Police Oversight Commission. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yes:  5  Bender, Okatch, Orozco, Soto, Tushnet
No:  0  None
Recused:  0  None
Abstain:  0  None
Absent:  1  Brown

 There being no further nominations, Patrick Weithers, Police Oversight Officer, declared the
nominations closed for Chair.

Commission.
